title: Migrated 160-server datacenter to Azure hybrid cloud
content: Led the migration of a 160-server on-premises datacenter for SchoolVision to Azure hybrid cloud. Migration included: SQL Server databases to Azure SQL, VB.NET APIs rewritten in C# ASP.NET Core deployed to Azure Container Apps (Linux), 300+ static web apps migrated to Azure Static Web Apps, Azure Front Door and API Gateway for security and routing, Azure VPN for private SQL access, Azure Key Vault for all secrets management, and Azure Functions for data ingestion pipelines. This is a signature enterprise achievement referenced in cloud/Azure proposals.
outcome: 160 servers migrated to Azure hybrid cloud; 300+ static web apps to Azure Static Web Apps

title: Multi-tenant SaaS architecture: 3,000 per-client SQL Server databases
content: Deep expertise in multi-tenant SaaS architecture. Pattern: each client has their own SQL Server database connected via a shared C# API layer. URL patterns use client placeholder. Azure API Gateway with wildcard subdomains per client. Shared Report API pattern across all tenant databases. Azure VPN for private database connectivity.

title: SQL Server expert: stored procedures, CTEs, indexing, replication
content: Deep SQL Server expertise over 25+ years. Preferred patterns: stored-procedure-driven architecture, CTE-first query design, view-heavy API layer, proactive index optimization, SQL Agent jobs, SQL Server dbmail alerting. Handles: deadlock detection, execution plan analysis, dynamic SQL, pivot/unpivot for reports, replication for multi-site sync, Azure SQL migration. Debug pattern: @DebugMode and @PreviewMode parameters on all stored procedures.

title: Azure cloud architect: App Service, Functions, Front Door, Key Vault, DevOps
content: Extensive Azure architecture across all major services: Azure SQL, App Service, Functions, Front Door, API Gateway, Key Vault, Static Web Apps, VPN, DevOps, Container Apps, ARM templates. Cost optimization experience. PowerShell for all Azure automation.

title: Upwork proposal style and tone preferences
content: Proposal style: direct, confident, specific — never flowery. Always includes: MBA credential, 25+ years enterprise experience, SchoolVision 20+ years education SaaS, 160-server Azure migration, 300+ static web apps migration, 3,000-client distributed SQL Server network, founding-to-scale narrative, demo prototype URL matching the job spec, no-cost/no-commitment call offer before the close. Never uses: Dear Hiring Manager, generic closings, clichés, sentences starting with I. Target length: 300-450 words. Ends with Warm regards,. Portfolio: servicevisionai.com and mvpcreator.servicevision.io.
